3. Current fixed scopeDirs list (internal/securitytest/doc.go)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

AST-enumerated first-party scopeDirs (exactly six entries, in source order):

  cmd/ch-oauth-ldap
  cmd/ch-jwt-verify
  internal/ldap
  internal/verification
  internal/identity
  internal/roles

Plus the separately AST-enumerated vendoredScope constant:

  third_party/ldapserver

(discoverSites reads direct .go files from each scope directory only — it
does not recurse into subdirectories; see §4 below.)

4. third_party/goldap is explicitly NOT an AST-enumerated scope
--------------------------------------------------------------------

third_party/goldap (the vendored, patched github.com/vjeantet/goldap
message package) is not a member of scopeDirs, is not vendoredScope, and
has no external-pinned rows in redaction-sites.tsv. It is production-
reachable (see production-nonstdlib-deps.txt / production-ldap-loc.tsv in
this same directory: github.com/vjeantet/goldap/message is part of
./cmd/ch-oauth-ldap's dependency closure) but its ~5,600 lines of BER
encode/decode code carry zero redaction-inventory coverage as of this
baseline. This is a pre-existing, honestly recorded gap in the current
inventory scope, not a claim that it is covered.

5. Pre-existing gap: integration/clickhouse/ha/session-probe
-----------------------------------------------------------------

integration/clickhouse/ha/session-probe is credential-bearing integration
tooling (it holds a same-socket LDAP session probe used by the manual HA
harness, run-ha.sh / compose-ha.yml) that lives entirely outside the fixed
six-directory scopeDirs list above, and is not vendoredScope either. It is
therefore not AST-enumerated by redaction_inventory_test.go at all. This is
recorded here explicitly, per plan §4.4/§50, as a known pre-existing scope
limitation — not claimed as covered by this or any other current security
inventory test.

6. Existing inventory tests: pass/fail on this baseline tree
-----------------------------------------------------------------

Command run on the unmodified HEAD e9c7c3c tree, from the module root:

  go test ./internal/securitytest -run RedactionInventory -count=1 -v
